criteria.description: Consecutive eligible same-path child calls render under one In <canonical agent path> heading with ordered action bullets and immediate delivery.
Different child paths, non-tool notices and deferred/current boundaries end groups; response budgets defer undeliverable actions without loss.
Recognized transformations retain complete details, multiline indentation and every classified operation while respecting overall activity budgets.
Source calls remain independently deduplicated and router-authored copies can be stripped without losing original history.
Unsupported displays stay bounded; unrelated behavior is preserved, the owning specification is updated, and focused tests cover the requested behavior.

preparation: bun install --cwd plugins --frozen-lockfile && go mod download && go generate ./internal/router/toolplugin
